source_reviews.independent_solution: Changes of state make it possible to control material form and energy transfer for practical purposes. An adequate open answer connects a learner-selected physical change to a practical purpose rather than merely naming states or asserting usefulness.

Temperature alone, motion alone and interaction alone are incomplete accounts. The modern source qualifies the molecular-material and usual dilute-gas descriptions.
